entities.summary: Thue Christiansen was a Greenlandic politician, teacher, and visual artist. He is best known as the designer of the flag of Greenland, which was adopted on 21 June 1985. A trained teacher, Christiansen was elected to the Inatsisartut for Siumut in 1979, when Greenland was granted home rule. He was the Greenlandic Minister of Culture and Education from 1979 until 1983.
